data.title: Satisfy opens Paris flagship(s)
data.description: After gaining serious momentum globally in recent years, the high-end running and lifestyle brand Satisfy is returning to its Parisian roots with its first permanent flagship store — or rather, two.

data.title: George Lucas unveils art galaxy at his new LA museum
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - George Lucas, the legendary creator of the "Star Wars" saga, on Wednesday showcased his long-awaited Museum of Narrative Art, the culmination of nearly two decades of work and numerous obstacles.

data.title: Purin Film Fund opens applications  for sixth edition of Short Film Camp
data.description: <p>The Purin Film Fund is now accepting applications for a 10-day workshop for filmmakers from Myanmar, Thailand, Laos and Cambodia until Sept 25.</p>

data.title: Upcycled Pak Klong Talat  materials form 'After Faith'
data.description: <p>Explore the intricate connections between belief, people, objects and society during "After Faith", which is running at Makers' Loft, 3rd floor of Pak Klong Talat, Chakkraphet Road, until Nov 30.</p>

data.title: Nat Studio marks  41st anniversary
data.description: <p>Twenty young pianists will take the stage during "Cream Of Nat Studio &ndash; A Journey Of Growth Through Music", at Sala Sudasiri Sobha, Lat Phrao 41 yaek 7-2, on Sunday at 4pm.</p>

data.title: Rupert Murdoch 'very happy' to be played by Guy Pearce in new film
data.description: VENICE - Australian-born media mogul Rupert Murdoch is "very happy" to see compatriot Guy Pearce play him in a new, largely sympathetic movie about his early business life, the actor said on Wednesday.

data.title: US run by ‘least qualified people’, says George Clooney
data.description: VENICE - Veteran film star George Clooney said on Wednesday the United States would surmount an “unfortunate” time in its history under the Trump administration, calling it a government run by the “least qualified people”.

data.title: Venice to roll out red carpet for Clooney
data.description: VENICE - The Venice Film Festival kicks off on the sun-splashed Lido with a bang on Wednesday, with the glamorous cinema showcase handing George Clooney a lifetime achievement award on its opening night.

data.title: Olivia Rodrigo’s Daisy Chain Fields festival earns $20m for women’s charities
data.description: Pop star Olivia Rodrigo has turned her first music festival into a US$20 million fundraising effort for women’s causes, with the singer’s Daisy Chain Fields drawing 45,000 fans to Great Park in Irvine, California this past Aug 29.

data.title: Galliano pulls Met exhibit after antisemitism backlash
data.description: The fashion designer John Galliano has agreed to cancel a planned exhibition of his work that was to kick off New York’s fabled Met Gala in 2027, following criticism from donors and political leaders over his past antisemitic remarks.

data.title: Rain boots favoured by British royals are Bangkok-bound
data.description: Iconic Wellington boots are arriving in Thailand just in time for the rainy season, with the British heritage footwear brand Hunter opening its first store in the country at Iconsiam.

data.title: Vacheron Constantin’s newest collection is a tribute to the animal kingdom
data.description: Six extraordinary timepieces transform rare decorative crafts into tiny scenes of the natural world, pushing centuries-old artisanal techniques to microscopic proportions.

data.title: Finding joy in a chaotic world
data.description: <p>Paphakorn Srikunrayakorn, better known as Newyear, is celebrated for her vibrant illustrations and clean, unique linework that brings a sense of joy and comfort. Due to her outstanding work, Paphakorn has collaborated with numerous leading global brands, such as Nike, Bvlgari, Samsung, Sephora and others.</p>

data.title: Century Theatre Sukhumvit has an offer you can't refuse

data.title: 'Shared Sensibilities' boosts Thai-Korean art ties
data.description: <p>Thailand Cultural Ministry's Contemporary Art and Culture Office (OCAC) and Cheongju Craft Biennale Organising Committee recently launched "Shared Sensibilities", a Thailand-South Korea exchange exhibition at the Ratchadamnoen Contemporary Art Center, with the objective to promote exchange in contemporary art through craftsmanship and strengthening bilateral relations.</p>

data.title: When family life becomes music
data.description: <p>The Royal Bangkok Symphony Music School recently presented another successful and meaningful instalment of its Sounds Of Wireless concert series, drawing a full house to the elegant lobby of 140 Wireless.</p>

data.title: Staying in the spotlight
data.description: <p>Fame is supposed to belong to the next big thing. A new face arrives, the spotlight shifts and yesterday's star learns the cruel rule of show business -- someone is always waiting to take your place. Muang Marnya The Musical embraces this familiar mythology and then, rather unexpectedly, begins to question it.</p>

data.title: Celine Dion arrives in France for comeback shows
data.description: PARIS - Canadian superstar Celine Dion arrived in Paris on Friday two weeks ahead of the first of her sold-out comeback concerts in the French capital.

data.title: Revamped MasterChef Asia returns
data.description: The revamped reality competition MasterChef Asia is set to premiere on HBO Max on Sept 22, as well as TLC and Discovery Channel on Sept 22 and 23, respectively.
